shorts.title: GTA 6: How to Fast Travel
shorts.description:
Call Paradise Taxi from your phone right after GTA 6's first mission. Buck Me unlocks RydeMe, which charges your bank account.
Driving or riding? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: Stop Spamming Zombix
shorts.description:
Taking Zombix back to back in GTA 6 builds a tolerance, so each dose heals less. Get to cover first, then heal.
Did you know this one? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: Chapter 3 Jewelry Store Money
shorts.description:
Jewelry stores unlock in GTA 6 Chapter 3 after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, about $10K to $25K a store, guides say. Stop the alarm, kill the security and sell to Yasmani.
Hit one yet? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
